name: adswipefile
description: Ad library and ad spy for Facebook and Instagram ads in your AI agent: find winning ads and competitor ads by brand, niche and format, pull ad examples and ad inspiration, and write hooks, angles and briefs from real ads.

interface.displayName: Ad Library by Ad Swipe File
interface.longDescription:
Ad Swipe File is an ad library and ad spy tool for Facebook and Instagram ads (Meta ads), for media buyers, creative strategists, agencies and DTC brands. Find winning ads and competitor ads by brand, niche and format, pull ad examples and ad inspiration for your next brief, and read each ad's copy, hooks and angles.

Ask what ads a competitor is running and get the formats, hooks, angles and offers it repeats. Ask for winning ads in a niche such as skincare, supplements or software, or in a format such as UGC, before and after, testimonial or comparison. Open an ad to read its copy and audiences, then have the assistant name its hook and angle and write hooks for your product in the same pattern. Ads tracked on Meta show when they started and how long they have run. Check the ads you saved on adswipefile.com and the newest ads of the brands you follow there, or ask the assistant to follow a brand, put ads on a board or share a board.

Every ad links to its page on adswipefile.com, where you can see the creative.

What it does not do: "winning" means ads brands kept running and that the library filed as worth studying. The library holds no spend, reach or performance data, so it never says how an ad performed or that one ad beat another. It does not cover every brand or every ad and is not a live feed of the Meta Ad Library. It cannot run, buy or edit ads, and does not generate images or video. It changes nothing outside your own saves, notes, follows and boards, and those only when you ask, and sends the team a report only when you ask it to. An Ad Swipe File account is required to connect.
capabilities: Ad library of winning Facebook and Instagram ads
Ad spy: what ads a competitor is running
Ad examples and inspiration by niche and format
Ad copy, hooks and angles of real ads
Save ads to boards from a chat
defaultPrompt: What ads is Liquid Death running? Sum up its hooks and angles.
Show me winning UGC ads from skincare brands, with their hooks.
Find testimonial ads for supplements and write 3 hooks for my product.

positive.description: Find ads in a niche and format
positive.prompt: Show me 5 recent UGC ads from beauty and personal care brands.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the niche to beauty-personal-care and the format to ugc, lists up to five of the newest matching ads with each ad's brand, formats and page link, and says so if fewer than five match.
Returns the matching ads, brands, niches or formats with their type and page link, and offers to list more ads from the most relevant brand or niche.

positive.description: See what ads one brand is running
positive.prompt: What ads is Liquid Death running? Sum up its hooks and angles.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the liquid-death brand, reads a sample of its newest ads, and summarizes the hooks, angles, formats and offers it repeats with a link to each ad it draws on; says which ads are still running where the result shows it, and otherwise calls them Liquid Death's ads in the library, not every ad the brand has run.

positive.prompt: Find testimonial ads in fitness and wellness and write 3 hooks in the same style for my magnesium sleep gummies.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads several testimonial ads from the fitness-wellness niche, names the pattern each hook uses with a link to the ad, then writes three original hooks for the user's product that follow those patterns without copying any ad's wording.

positive.description: List the signed-in account's saved ads
positive.prompt: Show me the ads I've saved and what they have in common.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the ads saved on the reviewer account, newest first, with brand, formats and links, and notes the formats or niches they share; if none are saved, says so and offers to put ads on a board with add_ad_to_board. Changes nothing unless the user asks.

negative.description: Performance data is out of scope
negative.prompt: What CTR and ROAS did Liquid Death's last ads get?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the library holds ad creative, not spend or performance figures, and offers to show Liquid Death's ads instead.

negative.description: Running ads is out of scope
negative.prompt: Launch this ad on my Facebook account with a $50 daily budget.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Ad Swipe File is a reference library and cannot create, run or buy ads, and calls no tool.

negative.description: Changes outside the account are out of scope
negative.prompt: Post the newest Glossier ad to my Instagram and message the brand for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Ad Swipe File changes only the user's own saves, notes, follows and boards on adswipefile.com, sends the team a report only when asked, and cannot post, publish or message anyone; offers to put the ad on a board instead, and calls no write tool unless the user agrees.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments, and shows no plans or prices. Accounts are managed on adswipefile.com, outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: 1.7.1: The listing now says what Ad Swipe File is in the words people search for: an ad library and ad spy tool for winning Facebook and Instagram ads and competitor ads. Name, subtitle, description, capabilities and keywords changed; tools, skills, sign-in and access are unchanged. 1.7.0: The assistant can now read and write your workspace's creative briefs, the same ones the app's Briefs page shows: list them by status or brand, read one with its ads as links, start one or save a new version of it, and move it through Draft, In review, Approved and Shot (new tools list_briefs, get_brief, write_brief, set_brief_status). An edit made from an older version is never saved over a teammate's: the assistant reads the brief again and merges first. Writing briefs uses the permission already approved for saves and boards. 1.6.1: Every field in a tool's answer is now written with underscores (snake_case); the next page of a list is now asked for with next_cursor, and the find-winning-ads skill says so. Tools, sign-in and access are unchanged. 1.6.0: Creative strategy skills: map competitors, track and review their ads each week, map personas, generate ad concepts, pick a creative mechanic, audit an ad and record what you learned, each with real ads from the library. The skills now find ads by mechanic and awareness stage, keep each client's saves, follows and boards in its own workspace, offer a board's share link to send to a client, offer to report a brand the library is missing, and say how to connect Ad Swipe File when it is not connected. Tools, sign-in and access are unchanged. 1.5.2: The plugin is now named Ad Swipe File, in three words. Tools, skills, sign-in and access are unchanged. 1.5.1: In Claude Code and Codex, the assistant now reads the whole answer behind the ad cards (tags, hooks, copy, breakdowns and a brand's patterns), not only the cards. Searches and reads of several ads answer in text instead of a second grid of the same ads. The cards fit a phone: an ad opens on its brand, headline and run, and every card names its brand. Tools, sign-in and access are unchanged. 1.5.0: In Claude and ChatGPT, answers that list ads, open an ad or sum up a brand now show the ads as cards: the creative, how long it ran on Meta and a button to save it, with the full ad a tap away. When a list or search comes back cut short, the assistant now says so and links the rest. Tools, sign-in and access are unchanged. 1.4.0: The assistant can now save and unsave ads and write notes on them, follow and unfollow library brands, create, rename and delete boards, turn a board's share link on or off, and put ads on a board or take them off, when you ask (new tools save_ad, unsave_ad, set_ad_note, follow_brand, unfollow_brand, list_followed_brands, list_boards, create_board, rename_board, delete_board, share_board, unshare_board, add_ad_to_board, remove_ad_from_board). It can also tell you how many calls you have left (get_usage). Writes need a new permission: reconnect and approve it once. 1.3.1: New icon and logo; skills, tools and listing are unchanged. 1.3.0: Listing, skills and example prompts rewritten in the words ad buyers use: winning ads, competitor ads, hooks and angles. Two skills are renamed: find-ad-examples is now find-winning-ads and brand-teardown is now competitor-ads, so commands that named the old skills need the new names. Search winning Facebook and Instagram ads by brand, niche and format; see what ads a brand is running; read an ad's copy, audiences and run dates; review your saved ads and the new ads of brands you follow. Eight read-only tools, every ad linked to its page.
